learner_starting_state: Can trace an offline client and distinguish model capabilities, but may conflate analysis of existing visuals with generation of new media.
learner_ending_state: Can choose image analysis, multimodal visual prompting, image generation, or video generation and preserve safe input/output media handling.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer forms across four visual workload patterns and two client-flow safeguards per form, then explain one choice without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 scope and current Azure Vision direction trace to official Microsoft sources; scenarios, reasons, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Do not implement from deprecated Image Analysis 4.0 examples; reverify current models, SDKs, operations, endpoints, authentication, formats, regions, quotas, pricing, and preview status.

notes: Offline scenario package; opens, uploads, generates, or stores no real media.
